```python
    f.write(vif_table.round(3).to_string(index=False))

    f.write("\n\n" + "="*70 + "\n")
    f.write("INFLUENCE THRESHOLDS\n")
    f.write("="*70 + "\n")
    f.write(f"N = {n}\n")
    f.write(f"Number of model parameters including constant = {p}\n")
    f.write(f"Cook's distance threshold (4/N): {cook_threshold:.3f}\n")
    f.write(f"Leverage threshold (2p/N): {leverage_threshold:.3f}\n")
    f.write("Studentised residual flag: |residual| > 2\n")

    f.write("\n\n" + "="*70 + "\n")
    f.write("INFLUENCE DIAGNOSTICS BY COUNTRY\n")
    f.write("="*70 + "\n")
    f.write(influence_table.round(3).to_string(index=False))

    f.write("\n\n" + "="*70 + "\n")
    f.write("POTENTIALLY INFLUENTIAL OBSERVATIONS\n")
    f.write("="*70 + "\n")

    if len(potentially_influential) == 0:
        f.write("No observations exceeded the specified diagnostic thresholds.\n")
    else:
        f.write(
            potentially_influential
            .round(3)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

print(f"Saved to: {output_file}")
```

```python
# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# LEAVE-ONE-OUT ANALYSIS OF INFLUENTIAL OBSERVATIONS
# PRIMARY MULTIVARIABLE GHSI MODEL
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SAME VARIABLES AS PRIMARY MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

predictors = [
    "LOG_GDP",
    "WGI_SCORE",
    "LOG_GOV_HEALTH",
    "LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH",
    "LOG_POPULATION",
    "GINI"
]

# Recreate the exact analysis dataset
sensitivity_data = df_analysis_inform[
    ["COUNTRY_NAME", "GHSI"] + predictors
].dropna().copy()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. COUNTRIES IDENTIFIED AS INFLUENTIAL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

influential_countries = [
    "South Africa",
    "Egypt, Arab Rep.",
    "Equatorial Guinea",
    "Seychelles"
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. FUNCTION TO RUN MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def run_model(data):

    X = sm.add_constant(data[predictors])
    y = data["GHSI"]

    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

    return model


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. FULL MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------------------

full_model = run_model(sensitivity_data)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. STORE RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

results = []

# Full model
results.append({
    "Model": "Full sample",
    "Excluded_Country": "None",
    "N": int(full_model.nobs),
    "R_squared": full_model.rsquared,
    "Adjusted_R_squared": full_model.rsquared_adj,
    "F_statistic": full_model.fvalue,
    "F_p_value": full_model.f_pvalue,

    "LOG_GDP_coef": full_model.params["LOG_GDP"],
    "LOG_GDP_p": full_model.pvalues["LOG_GDP"],

    "WGI_SCORE_coef": full_model.params["WGI_SCORE"],
    "WGI_SCORE_p": full_model.pvalues["WGI_SCORE"],

    "LOG_GOV_HEALTH_coef": full_model.params["LOG_GOV_HEALTH"],
    "LOG_GOV_HEALTH_p": full_model.pvalues["LOG_GOV_HEALTH"],

    "LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH_coef": full_model.params["LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH"],
    "LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH_p": full_model.pvalues["LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH"],

    "LOG_POPULATION_coef": full_model.params["LOG_POPULATION"],
    "LOG_POPULATION_p": full_model.pvalues["LOG_POPULATION"],

    "GINI_coef": full_model.params["GINI"],
    "GINI_p": full_model.pvalues["GINI"]
})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. LEAVE-ONE-OUT MODELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for country in influential_countries:

    sensitivity_sample = sensitivity_data[
        sensitivity_data["COUNTRY_NAME"] != country
    ].copy()

    model = run_model(sensitivity_sample)

    results.append({
        "Model": f"Excluding {country}",
        "Excluded_Country": country,
        "N": int(model.nobs),
        "R_squared": model.rsquared,
        "Adjusted_R_squared": model.rsquared_adj,
        "F_statistic": model.fvalue,
        "F_p_value": model.f_pvalue,

        "LOG_GDP_coef": model.params["LOG_GDP"],
        "LOG_GDP_p": model.pvalues["LOG_GDP"],

        "WGI_SCORE_coef": model.params["WGI_SCORE"],
        "WGI_SCORE_p": model.pvalues["WGI_SCORE"],

        "LOG_GOV_HEALTH_coef": model.params["LOG_GOV_HEALTH"],
        "LOG_GOV_HEALTH_p": model.pvalues["LOG_GOV_HEALTH"],

        "LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH_coef": model.params["LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH"],
        "LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH_p": model.pvalues["LOG_PRIVATE_HEALTH"],

        "LOG_POPULATION_coef": model.params["LOG_POPULATION"],
        "LOG_POPULATION_p": model.pvalues["LOG_POPULATION"],

        "GINI_coef": model.params["GINI"],
        "GINI_p": model.pvalues["GINI"]
    })


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. CREATE RESULTS TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sensitivity_results = pd.DataFrame(results)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. DISPLAY MAIN SENSITIVITY RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("LEAVE-ONE-OUT SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS")
print("="*80)

print(
    sensitivity_results[
        [
            "Model",
            "N",
            "R_squared",
            "Adjusted_R_squared",
            "F_statistic",
            "F_p_value"
        ]
    ]
    .round(3)
    .to_string(index=False)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. DISPLAY COEFFICIENT ROBUSTNESS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("COEFFICIENT ROBUSTNESS")
print("="*80)

for variable in predictors:

    print(f"\n{variable}")

    display_table = sensitivity_results[
        [
            "Model",
            f"{variable}_coef",
            f"{variable}_p"
        ]
    ].copy()

    display_table.columns = [
        "Model",
        "Coefficient",
        "P-value"
    ]

    print(
        display_table
        .round(3)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. SAVE COMPLETE SENSITIVITY RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sensitivity_results.round(4).to_csv(
    "Appendix_Leave_One_Out_Sensitivity_Analysis.csv",
    index=False
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. COMPACT TABLE FOR REPORTING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reporting_table = sensitivity_results[
    [
        "Model",
        "N",
        "R_squared",
        "Adjusted_R_squared",
        "WGI_SCORE_coef",
        "WGI_SCORE_p",
        "LOG_POPULATION_coef",
        "LOG_POPULATION_p"
    ]
].copy()

reporting_table.columns = [
    "Model",
    "N",
    "R_squared",
    "Adjusted_R_squared",
    "WGI_Coefficient",
    "WGI_P_Value",
    "Population_Coefficient",
    "Population_P_Value"
]

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("KEY ROBUSTNESS RESULTS")
print("="*80)

print(
    reporting_table
    .round(3)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

reporting_table.round(4).to_csv(
    "Appendix_Key_Sensitivity_Results.csv",
    index=False
)


print("\nSensitivity analysis complete.")
print("Files saved:")
print("- Appendix_Leave_One_Out_Sensitivity_Analysis.csv")
print("- Appendix_Key_Sensitivity_Results.csv")
```
